g.text: BC-03 Catalog & Commercial Policy — Tactical Domain Model (TARGET / V1)
+resolvePrice(skuId: SkuId, customerId: CustomerAccountId, at: Instant): ResolvedPrice
+findActiveFor(skuId: SkuId, customerId: CustomerAccountId, at: Instant): ResolvedPrice
